text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Mile Championship. Taiki Shuttle
had
declared quite a while back that she
was going to
take on this race.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeehaw! Victory is mine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She just had an incredible victory at a
G2 race
right before this, and she's
charging into this one
with unbelievable
momentum. But on our end...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We've done everything we could,
Trainer... We
really did.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's go. It's finally time for my first race
against
Taiki in the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Even though I'm further along in
my
career...
choice_data_list: ああ、ドンと受けて立とう！
うん、ドンと受けて立とう！

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It somehow doesn't feel that way. I know
how
strong Taiki is better than anyone
else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Taiki Shuttle has come ready to
win,
but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, Pearl... I heard, y'know...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: 'Bout your throat. How're ya feelin'?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I wish we coulda run together when you
were
feelin' a bit better...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Aww, thanks for thinking of me, Taiki.
But...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to worry about me.
Quite the
opposite, actually.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy I get to run with you in my
current
condition.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...What? But why? Don't your throat
issues make
it harder for you to breathe?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl's eyes shine brighter
than I've
ever seen them before.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everyone just tries to shelter themselves
so they
can live a safe life. They try to
be content with
their own abilities.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But I couldn't let myself live that way.
I've been
struck with some hard luck,
that's for sure.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yet it was these very same hardships
that helped
me discover new
possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I discovered a new way of running, new
tactics,
and new determination!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I even stumbled upon a certain
truth! It's
what you might call the real
meaning of running.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: The real meanin'?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's not really living if you just go
with the
natural flow of things.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's right! What's finite is infinite!
What's
limited is unlimited! And even
illnesses can give
you wings of freedom!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I imagined a new self, molded myself in
that
image, and honed it to
perfection—all so I could
run against
you, Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Surpassing you as my new self would be
way more
stupendous than triumphing
over you as I was
before.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I don't reckon I get it, but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
There is one thing I do get! An' it's that
you're just
fine!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly right, so please, don't
hold back.
Come at me with all you've
got.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And while we're at it... I plan on betting

something important on this race.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If I'm no match for you and end up lost
in the
pack...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Then that's it. It'll be the end of the line
for me. If
I can't win here, how can I even
hope of taking on
the rest of the world?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This is a test. A test for the new me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She turns to me with a hint of sadness in
her eyes.
As her trainer, it's my duty to
calmly and
objectively judge her running
today.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But, obviously, I have no intention of

surrendering here!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
All right, Taiki! Let's enjoy the breadth
of our
possibilities to the fullest
today! ♪ Time to get
out there on this
track made for stars!
